title: Weaker foot
text: You have a chance to shoot, but the ball is on your weaker foot. A defender is closing in from your strong side.
tip: Practise with both feet so you never have to choose.

options.text: Touch it onto your stronger foot
options.why: Your stronger foot gives a cleaner strike, but the touch moves you towards the defender. Only do it if there's room.
They have a defender nearby too. You have the clearer chance.
A quick shot with your weaker foot beats a perfect one that gets blocked.
